title: ledge event
description: A card in the bar: a headline, and optionally a report with the details. Send it to POST /event, or pipe it to `ledge event`.

block.description: One part of a report. `type` says which, and so which other properties it takes. All text is shown as plain text, never as HTML.

paragraph.description: A paragraph. Line breaks in it are kept.

table.description: A table: column headings, and rows of cells. A row with fewer cells than columns leaves the rest empty; extra cells are dropped.

list.description: A bulleted list, or numbered with "ordered": true.

code.description: Preformatted text, such as a log or a command's output, in a fixed-width font. Long lines scroll sideways.

note.description: A callout in a colour: a named colour (green, yellow, red, blue or gray, as for status pills) or #rrggbb. Default gray.

link.description: A link that opens in your browser. Only http(s) urls.

kind.description: Optional; an object without `kind` is an event.

id.description: Send an existing id to replace that event. Without one, a new id is generated and returned.

tags.description: Short labels shown as pills at the right of the card's bottom line.

description.description: A line or two under the title.

url.description: Instead of a report: clicking the card runs `open <url>`, so it opens in whatever app handles it (https: in your browser, vscode: in VS Code). Must start with a scheme.

priority.description: Sorts the card and colours its left edge.

source.description: Who sent it (default: manual). A section ({source, items}) replaces all of a source's events.

report.description: The details, shown in the report window when the card is clicked: a list of blocks, drawn top to bottom in the bar's theme. To change a report, send the event again with the same id.

expires.description: When the card goes away: an ISO 8601 time, or a duration from now such as "30m", "4h" or "2d".

not.description: `url` and `report` can't both be set: clicking the card either opens the url or shows the report
